page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.2-8 is a flexible compute instance powered by x86_64 AMD EPYC 9J45 processors running at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. Configured with 2 physical cores and 2 threads per core, the virtual machine provides 4 dedicated vCPUs alongside 8.0 GB of system memory. This resource profile yields a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio, offering 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated local NVMe storage and operates without discrete hardware acceleration, featuring zero GPUs. Persistent storage must be attached via remote block volumes. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

With its 1:2 CPU-to-memory allocation, VM.Standard.E6.Flex.2-8 functions effectively as a compute-oriented node where processing capability takes precedence over large memory footprint. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent execution environments. It is suited for moderate compute-focused workloads, small application backends, batch processing, utility services, and CI/CD build agents.
